note: Both halves now tagged both ways. Community half: TestRFC8955CommunityPolicyAcceptsAPermittedFlowSpecRoute (ipv4/flow and ipv4/flow-vpn with 65001:100 accepted) and TestRFC8955CommunityPolicyRejectsADeniedFlowSpecRoute (denied community first-match and implicit deny reject a FlowSpec route); revert records on evaluateCommunities. Prefix half: filter_prefix flowspec_test.go pair (accept, reject, missing, mixed), no record. Both at the plugin entry point: no .ci drives a FlowSpec UPDATE through a configured community filter in the running daemon. Rejudged 2026-10-17 (independent reader) after the owner-approved 6019dd0675 change to TestPrefixPolicyFiltersFlowSpecDestination: the filter input prefix changed from nlri to mp, the section keyword the filter text now uses for MP_REACH families. The cases are unchanged: ipv4/flow and ipv4/flow-vpn destinations inside 10.0.0.0/8 ge 16 le 24 must be accepted, and /25, out-of-range, invalid and mixed destinations rejected, with no unicast rewrite. A parser that stopped reading the mp form would fail the accept cases, and a policy that stopped applying would fail the reject cases. Package re-run green 2026-10-17.
